item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J00560","case1_error":"Uses purchase cost per egg instead of selling price to calculate sales needed to recover capital.","case2_error":"Treats five surviving brown eggs as lost white eggs in 3B−5=7, then subtracts only surviving white eggs from the total.","reason":"The first substitutes the wrong price; the second confuses egg categories and surviving versus broken counts.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00561","case1_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 57+190+152 as 309 instead of 399.","case2_error":"Gives unsupported final earnings of 6351 after a correct formula, whose value is 6318.","reason":"The first explicitly miscalculates a displayed sum; the second supplies a wrong final number without showing which calculation failed.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00562","case1_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 35×0.2857 as 9.5; the exact required amount is 10 pounds.","case2_error":"Gives unsupported final answer 29 after correctly writing 65−(22+24), which equals 19.","reason":"The first shows an erroneous multiplication evaluation; the second gives a wrong final number without an explicit numerical evaluation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00563","case1_error":"Omits the initial 50-yard width, treating 80 yards as the required increase.","case2_error":"Treats one student's 105 pens as the entire pool, omitting multiplication by three.","reason":"Omitting an initial additive quantity differs from confusing a per-person quantity with the aggregate total.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00564","case1_error":"Performs four halving-and-donation rounds when only two are requested.","case2_error":"Explicitly instructs subtracting the same $400 expense again after already deducting it; final 1100 is also unsupported.","reason":"Both explicitly repeat an operation beyond its required count.
